purpose: Separate upstream market qualification from causally available provider-news timing without claiming to understand catalyst quality.

source_scanner.news_availability_basis: provider published_at less than or equal to decision_time

feature_definitions.name: provider_news_state
feature_definitions.meaning: Tri-state provider view at decision time: present, provider-relative none, or unknown fail-closed.

feature_definitions.name: provider_news_present_at_activation
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether provider news was already present on the candidate's causal market-qualification row.

feature_definitions.name: provider_news_event_count_as_of
feature_definitions.meaning: Count of provider events published by the decision time.

feature_definitions.name: provider_news_event_count_change_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Change in the as-of event count since the immediately prior candidate minute.

feature_definitions.name: new_provider_news_became_available_this_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether one or more additional provider events first became available during this candidate minute.

feature_definitions.name: provider_news_state_changed_from_prior_minute
feature_definitions.meaning: Whether the tri-state provider view changed since the immediately prior candidate minute.

feature_definitions.name: observed_provider_news_state_tenure_minutes
feature_definitions.meaning: Consecutive observed candidate minutes in the current provider-news state.

feature_definitions.name: first_provider_news_published_at_as_of
feature_definitions.meaning: Earliest causally available provider publication timestamp as of the decision.

feature_definitions.name: latest_provider_news_published_at_as_of
feature_definitions.meaning: Latest causally available provider publication timestamp as of the decision.

feature_definitions.name: seconds_since_first_provider_news
feature_definitions.meaning: Elapsed seconds from the first known provider publication to the decision.

feature_definitions.name: seconds_since_latest_provider_news
feature_definitions.meaning: Elapsed seconds from the latest known provider publication to the decision.

feature_definitions.name: seconds_from_activation_to_first_provider_news
feature_definitions.meaning: Signed seconds from market qualification to the first provider publication; positive means market qualification came first.

feature_definitions.name: candidate_qualified_before_first_provider_news
feature_definitions.meaning: Once a first provider event is known, whether market qualification preceded its publication.

explicit_nonfeatures: no headline relevance or materiality classification
interpretation_limit: Provider event timing can show when a headline became available relative to market motion, but it cannot establish that the headline caused the move, was relevant to the symbol, was novel or material, or matched the active trading theme.
